description: Scroll a running profile's page by `amount` pixels (1 to 20000) in direction up, down, left or right, with mouse-wheel steps at the pointer's position. Like a real wheel, a scrollable area under the pointer scrolls instead of the page — after a click inside such an area, scroll there, or click outside it first. On a macOS profile the distance varies a few percent around `amount`, like a real wheel; the result reports the pixels actually scrolled.

profile_id.description: UUID of a running profile (launch_profile first)

name: scroll
